metaDescription: Order custom poly propylene badge id holders in bulk. Durable, clear, and perfect for events or daily use. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Poly propylene badge holders offer a lightweight, durable alternative to vinyl or PVC, resisting cracking and yellowing over time. Ideal for trade shows, corporate security, or school IDs, these clear holders provide excellent visibility for printed badges while holding up to daily wear. Choose from vertical or horizontal orientations, and add your logo or custom text with screen printing or pad printing for a professional look that lasts.
heroAltText: Custom poly propylene badge id holders in clear plastic, ideal for name badges and security IDs with clip or lanyard
